excluded_datasets.arc_challenge: Secondary compute-bounded comparator excludes ARC-Challenge because broad multiple-choice coverage is already represented by MMLU-Pro; ARC-Challenge remains in the full 18-cell primary and RQ3 analyses.
excluded_datasets.truthfulqa: Secondary compute-bounded comparator excludes TruthfulQA to preserve the 72-hour single-A100 envelope; TruthfulQA remains in the full 18-cell primary and RQ3 analyses.

execution_order: Generate all calibration/test auxiliary samples, evaluate every pre-registered eligible cell, run paired per-cell comparisons, then macro-aggregate the complete frozen repeated-sampling subset.
